title: Zephyrine and the Cover
author: August Galloway
blurb: Ulyana Thornbury, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
